summary: Third Coast Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $17.0625 per share on its 6.75% Series A Convertible Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock, payable July 15, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration on preferred stock, not a special situation. The filing includes no acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender, restructuring, or other special event. The registrant acts solely as the issuer of the dividend. No deal terms, M&A mechanics, or strategic changes are present. This is a standard periodic payment obligation with no risk-arb or structural complexity.
